transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hello. I'm seeking help today because I've been struggling with uncontrollable repetitive behaviors and rituals. They are starting to completely take over my daily life, and I don't know how to stop them.
Do you have unwanted, intrusive thoughts or images that make you feel driven to do these rituals, or is your anxiety more like constant worry about many everyday things?

It's not really general worry, but more of an intense, driving anxiety that something terrible will happen if I don't do these rituals. I feel this overwhelming internal urge to perform them just to make that terrifying feeling go away.
Do you recognize that these thoughts and rituals are excessive or unreasonable, and have you tried to resist them?

I'm not entirely sure if they are unreasonable because they feel so absolutely necessary to me in the moment. I find them incredibly difficult to resist, and trying to stop just makes the anxiety unbearable.
Are you completely certain that something terrible really will happen if you don’t do the rituals, or do you have any doubt that this fear might be coming from your own mind?

I'm not completely certain, to be honest. I feel this overwhelming urge to do them to prevent something bad from happening, but I do sometimes worry that it might just be my mind playing tricks on me.
About how much time do these rituals take each day, and are they interfering with work, school, or relationships?

I haven't tracked the exact amount of time they take each day, but they do feel quite time-consuming and disruptive. They definitely make it hard to get through my normal daily routine and focus on other things.
What kinds of rituals do you do most often, like checking, cleaning, counting, repeating, or arranging things?

I do several of those, actually. I spend a lot of time washing my hands and cleaning things, and I constantly check the door locks and the stove to make sure everything is safe. I also feel forced to arrange items on my desk at very precise angles to help ease my anxiety.
Have you ever had sudden onset of these symptoms after a medical illness, head injury, or starting a new medication or substance?

I'm not really sure, but I don't recall these behaviors starting suddenly after an illness, head injury, or any new medication. As far as I can remember, they seemed to develop more gradually over time.
How long have you been having these intrusive fears and rituals, and did they begin in childhood, adolescence, or adulthood?

To be honest, I'm not entirely sure exactly when these behaviors first started. I can't really say whether they began back in my childhood, during my teenage years, or as an adult. They've just been a part of my life for a while now, and it's hard to pin down a specific timeline.
Have you ever had repeated motor tics or vocal tics, like blinking, shrugging, throat-clearing, or other movements or sounds you couldn’t control?

No, I have never experienced any uncontrollable motor or vocal tics like blinking, shrugging, or throat-clearing. My struggles are really just limited to the repetitive behaviors and mental rituals I described earlier.
Besides the behaviors you do physically, do you also have mental rituals like silently counting, repeating words, praying, or reviewing things in your mind to reduce the anxiety?

Yes, I definitely do those as well. I often find myself silently counting, repeating specific words, or praying in my head to help quiet the anxiety. It is the only way I can make myself feel safe in those moments.
